ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Empowering citizens with foundational AI and digital literacy certification.
key_benefits: Free certification and computer kit subsidy

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: PM-KISAN provides income support of Rs 6,000 per year to all landholding farmer families across India in three equal installments of Rs 2,000 every four months directly into their bank accounts via DBT.
key_benefits: Financial support of ₹6,000 per annum paid in 3 installments of ₹2,000 each every 4 months via Direct Benefit Transfer (DBT).

exclusions: Institutional landholders
Farmer families holding constitutional posts
Former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, MLCs, Mayors, District Panchayat Chairpersons
Serving or retired officers/employees of Central/State Govts (excluding Multi-Tasking Staff/Class IV/Group D)
Income tax payers in last assessment year
Professionals (Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, CAs, Architects) registered with professional bodies

required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (RoR / Khasra / Khatauni / Jamabandi)
Active Bank Account Passbook linked with Aadhaar & NPCI DBT enabled
offline_process: Visit nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or State Agriculture Department Nodal Officer / Revenue Office with land records and Aadhaar.

scheme_name: Ayushman Bharat - Pradhan Mantri Jan Arogya Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Health and Family Welfare
description: AB-PMJAY provides a health cover of Rs 5 lakh per family per year for secondary and tertiary care hospitalization to over 12 crore poor and vulnerable families (bottom 40% of population) based on SECC 2011 criteria.
key_benefits: Cashless and paperless access to healthcare services up to ₹5,00,000 per family per year across 27,000+ empaneled public and private hospitals across India.

exclusions: Families owning motorized vehicle (car, tractor, fishing boat)
Families with government employees
Families paying income tax or professional tax
Families owning more than 5 acres of irrigated land

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Ration Card / Family ID card / SECC verification letter
offline_process: Visit any Empaneled Health Care Provider (EHCP) hospital helpdesk (Ayushman Mitra) or Common Service Centre (CSC) with Ration Card and Aadhaar.

ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: PMAY-G aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas.
key_benefits: Financial assistance of ₹1,20,000 in plain areas and ₹1,30,000 in hilly/difficult/North-Eastern/IAP districts, plus ₹12,000 for toilet construction under SBM-G, and 90-95 days of unskilled labor wage under MGNREGS (~₹25,000).

exclusions: Families owning a pucca house anywhere in India
Families owning motorized 2/3/4 wheeler or agricultural equipment (tractor)
Families with members earning > Rs 15,000/month or paying income tax
Families with government employees

required_documents: Land ownership / Land possession certificate for house plot
offline_process: Applications are selected via Gram Sabha based on Awas+ survey list. Citizens can register through Gram Panchayat Secretary or Block Development Office (BDO).

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: PMAY-U addresses urban housing shortage among EWS/LIG and MIG categories by ensuring a pucca house to all eligible urban households through Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), Beneficiary Led Construction (BLC), Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP), and In-Situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR).
key_benefits: Up to ₹2.67 lakh interest subsidy on home loans (under CLSS) or direct central assistance of ₹1.5 lakh for new house construction / enhancement under BLC.

exclusions: The beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name or in the name of any member of their family anywhere in India.

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of all family members
Income Certificate / Salary Slips / ITR / Form 16
Proof of Land / Plot Ownership (for BLC component)
Affidavit affirming no other pucca house owned in India
Address Proof / Voter ID / Electricity Bill
offline_process: Visit Urban Local Body (ULB) / Municipal Corporation Office or Common Service Centre (CSC).

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: A government-backed small deposit savings scheme launched under the 'Beti Bachao Beti Padhao' campaign to secure the financial future, higher education, and marriage of the girl child with attractive tax-free interest rates (currently 8.2% p.a.).
key_benefits: High compound interest rate (8.2% p.a.), Section 80C tax deduction up to ₹1.5 lakh/year, completely tax-exempt interest and maturity amount (EEE status), deposits from ₹250 to ₹1.5 lakh per financial year.

exclusions: Girl child age exceeding 10 years at time of account opening
Non-Resident Indians (NRIs) or OCI cardholders
More than two accounts per family without certified proof of twin/triplet girls

required_documents: Birth Certificate of the girl child (with name registered)
Identity Proof of Parent / Legal Guardian (Aadhaar Card, PAN Card, Passport)
Address Proof of Parent / Legal Guardian (Aadhaar, Electricity Bill, Voter ID)
Passport size photographs of girl child and guardian
Medical Certificate in case of twin/triplet girls
offline_process: Visit any Post Office branch or authorized commercial bank (SBI, PNB, BoB, Canara, etc.) with the application form and required documents.

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: PMMY provides collateral-free loans up to Rs 20 lakh to non-corporate, non-farm small and micro enterprises across three categories: Shishu (up to Rs 50,000), Kishore (Rs 50,000 to Rs 5 lakh), and Tarun (Rs 5 lakh to Rs 10/20 lakh).
key_benefits: Collateral-free micro loans from ₹10,000 up to ₹20,00,000 with low interest rates, no processing fee for Shishu loans, and Mudra Debit Card for working capital flexibility.

exclusions: Defaulters with any bank or financial institution
Large corporations or non-micro enterprises
Direct farming/crop production activities (allied agriculture like dairy/poultry is allowed)

required_documents: Proof of Identity (Aadhaar Card / Voter ID / PAN Card / Passport)
Proof of Residence (Electricity bill / Telephone bill / Aadhaar)
Business Identity and Address Proof (Trade License / Registration Certificate / Udyam Registration)
Bank Statement for the last 6 months
Quotation of machinery/items to be purchased (for term loans)
Balance Sheet / Profit & Loss statement for last 2 years (for Tarun loans)
optional_documents: ITR for past 2 years (for loans above ₹2 lakh)
offline_process: Visit any Public Sector Bank, Private Bank, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), Small Finance Bank (SFB), or Micro Finance Institution (MFI).

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Old Age Pension Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: A non-contributory monthly pension scheme under National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) providing financial security to elderly citizens living Below Poverty Line (BPL).
key_benefits: Monthly pension of ₹200 to ₹500 (Central component) supplemented by ₹500 to ₹1,500 (State contribution), totaling ₹1,000 to ₹2,000/month directly deposited into bank account.

exclusions: Citizens receiving regular government/pension benefits from other government services
Non-BPL households or households paying income tax

required_documents: Age Proof (Birth Certificate, Voter ID, Aadhaar, School Leaving Certificate, or Medical Board Age Certificate)
BPL Ration Card / BPL Certificate verified by local authority
optional_documents: Income Certificate from Tehsildar / Revenue Officer
offline_process: Submit application to the Gram Panchayat / Village Accountant / Block Development Officer (BDO) in rural areas, or to Municipal Ward Office / District Social Welfare Officer in urban areas.

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: An accidental death and disability insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh coverage for accidental death and permanent total disability, and ₹1 lakh for permanent partial disability, at an annual premium of only ₹20.
key_benefits: ₹2 Lakh coverage for accidental death or total permanent disability and ₹1 Lakh for partial disability for an annual premium of just ₹20 auto-debited from bank account.

exclusions: Age below 18 or above 70 years
Non-availability of sufficient balance in bank account at the time of auto-debit (May 31st each year)
Closure of bank account

required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Account details
Nominee Details and Nominee Aadhaar/Identity Proof
offline_process: Visit the bank branch or post office where you hold a savings account and submit the 1-page PMSBY consent-cum-enrollment form, or activate via NetBanking / Mobile Banking app.

scheme_name: Pradhan Mantri Jeevan Jyoti Bima Yojana
ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: A life insurance scheme offering ₹2 lakh life cover on death due to any reason (natural or accidental) to all savings bank account holders aged 18 to 50 years at an annual premium of ₹436.
key_benefits: Life cover of ₹2,00,000 payable to the nominee upon the insured member's death due to any cause (disease, natural death, accident) for ₹436/year.

exclusions: Age below 18 or above 50 years (coverage continues up to age 55 if enrolled prior to age 50)
30-day initial lien period for non-accidental death claims from enrollment date
Insufficient bank balance during auto-debit window

required_documents: Savings Bank Account / Post Office Savings Account
Self-certification of good health (built into application form)
offline_process: Visit the bank branch where you have a savings bank account, fill out the simple PMJJBY consent slip, or enable through NetBanking/Mobile Banking.

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: A guaranteed pension scheme for unorganized sector workers administered by PFRDA, providing a guaranteed monthly pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 from age 60 based on contribution.
key_benefits: Guaranteed minimum monthly pension of ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 for life starting from age 60; same pension to spouse after subscriber's death, and full return of accumulated pension corpus to the nominee.

exclusions: Any citizen who is or has been an Income Tax payer under the Income Tax Act 1961 as of October 1, 2022
Beneficiaries covered under statutory social security schemes (EPFO, NPS, Govt pension)

required_documents: Active Savings Bank Account Passbook with auto-debit facility
offline_process: Visit the bank or post office branch where you have an account, fill out the APY registration form, select the pension slab (₹1000-₹5000), and enable auto-debit.

ministry: Ministry of Women and Child Development
description: A direct benefit transfer (DBT) scheme providing cash incentive of ₹5,000 in two installments for the first living child, and ₹6,000 in a single installment for a second girl child, to compensate for wage loss during pregnancy and childbirth.
key_benefits: Cash incentive of ₹5,000 for first child (₹3,000 upon ANC registration + ₹2,000 after child birth & vaccination) and ₹6,000 in single installment if the second child is a girl.

exclusions: Women who are in regular employment with Central or State Government or Public Sector Undertakings (PSUs)
Women who receive similar paid maternity benefits under any other law

required_documents: Mother and Child Protection (MCP) Card registered at Anganwadi / Health Centre
Aadhaar-linked Bank Account Passbook of the mother
Proof of belonging to target group (EWS certificate, Ration card, MGNREGA job card, Ayushman card)
offline_process: Register at the nearest Anganwadi Centre (AWC) or Primary Health Centre (PHC) through the Anganwadi Worker (AWW) or ASHA worker.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Comprehensive scheme supporting traditional artisans and craftspeople working with hands and tools across 18 traditional trades with recognition, skill upskilling, toolkit incentive of ₹15,000, and collateral-free credit support up to ₹3 lakh at 5% interest.
key_benefits: PM Vishwakarma Certificate & ID Card, 5-7 days basic skill training with ₹500/day stipend, ₹15,000 e-voucher for modern toolkits, and collateral-free enterprise development loans up to ₹3,00,000 (Tranche 1: ₹1L, Tranche 2: ₹2L) at concessional 5% interest rate.

exclusions: Persons who have availed loans under similar credit-based schemes (PMEGP, PM SVANidhi, Mudra) and have outstanding dues
Family members of government servants
Only one member per family is eligible

required_documents: Active Mobile Number linked with Aadhaar
offline_process: Enroll through any Common Service Centre (CSC) with biometric verification, followed by 3-stage verification (Gram Panchayat / ULB level, District Implementation Committee, Screening Committee).

ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
description: Micro-credit facility for urban street vendors providing collateral-free working capital loans starting with ₹10,000 (1st tranche), ₹20,000 (2nd tranche), and ₹50,000 (3rd tranche) with 7% interest subsidy on timely repayment and digital transaction cashbacks up to ₹1,200/year.
key_benefits: Collateral-free working capital loan of ₹10,000 (enhanced to ₹20k and ₹50k on timely repayment), 7% interest subsidy credited directly to bank account, and up to ₹100/month cashback for digital transactions.

exclusions: Non-vendors or vendors in non-notified rural areas without ULB recommendation
Willful loan defaulters with commercial banks

required_documents: Certificate of Vending (CoV) / Identity Card issued by Urban Local Body (ULB) OR Letter of Recommendation (LoR)
UPI ID / QR Code details (for digital cashback)
offline_process: Apply through Urban Local Body (ULB) / Town Vending Committee (TVC), or nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or Banking Correspondent (BC).

ministry: Ministry of Petroleum and Natural Gas
description: Provides deposit-free LPG connections along with free first refill and hotplate (stove) to adult women from poor households to ensure smoke-free rural kitchens and women's health.
key_benefits: Deposit-free LPG connection, financial assistance of ₹1,600 per connection, free first LPG refill cylinder, free 2-burner gas stove, and targeted subsidy of ₹300 per cylinder for up to 12 refills/year.

exclusions: Any existing active LPG connection in the same household
Male applicants (connection is issued exclusively in the name of the female head)

required_documents: Aadhaar Card of the applicant woman (e-KYC mandatory)
Ration Card showing family composition / 14-point family declaration form
Aadhaar of all adult family members listed in ration card
Bank Account Number and IFSC code
offline_process: Submit application form at the nearest LPG Distributor (Indane, Bharatgas, or HP Gas) or Common Service Centre (CSC).

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Comprehensive crop insurance scheme providing comprehensive financial risk cover against non-preventable natural risks from pre-sowing to post-harvest stages at extremely low premium rates (2% for Kharif, 1.5% for Rabi, 5% for commercial/horticultural crops).
key_benefits: Full sum insured payout for crop loss due to drought, flood, inundation, pests, landslides, hailstorm, cyclone, post-harvest losses. Farmers pay nominal premium (1.5% - 2%) while balance is subsidized by Central and State Governments.

exclusions: War, nuclear risks, malicious damage and preventable risks due to negligence
Losses arising after 14 days of harvesting (for post-harvest coverage window)

required_documents: Land Record Documents (RoR / Record of Rights / Land Possession Certificate / Khatauni)
Sowing Certificate / Crop Sowing Declaration issued by Patwari / Village Revenue Officer / Agriculture Officer
Tenant Agreement / Sharecropper Affidavit (if cultivating leased land)
offline_process: Enroll through Bank branches (where farmer has KCC / savings account), Primary Agricultural Credit Societies (PACS), or Common Service Centres (CSC).

ministry: Ministry of Finance
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise in manufacturing, services, agri-allied, or trading sector.
key_benefits: Composite loan (term loan and working capital) between ₹10,00,000 and ₹1,00,00,000 covering up to 85% of project cost with margin money requirements reduced to 15%. Repayable over 7 years with moratorium up to 18 months.

exclusions: Non-greenfield projects (existing business expansion)
Borrowers with default history in any financial institution

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with estimated cost, machinery quotations, and financial projections
Proof of Business Premise (Lease Deed / Rent Agreement / Title Deed)
Bank Account Statements for last 12 months
Company / Partnership / LLP Registration and MOA/AOA (if applicable)
optional_documents: Pollution Control Board clearances / Trade license
offline_process: Apply directly at any Scheduled Commercial Bank branch or through Small Industries Development Bank of India (SIDBI) / NABARD offices.

scheme_name: Post Matric Scholarship Scheme for SC/ST Students
ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Centrally sponsored scholarship scheme providing full financial assistance covering non-refundable compulsory course fees and maintenance allowance to Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) students pursuing Class 11, 12, ITI, Diploma, Undergraduate, and Postgraduate degrees.
key_benefits: 100% tuition and mandatory institutional fee reimbursement plus monthly maintenance allowance (₹2,500 to ₹13,500 per annum depending on course group and hosteller/day scholar status) transferred via DBT.

exclusions: Students holding another full scholarship from government source
Students enrolled in private unaccredited courses without government affiliation
Family income exceeding ₹2.50 lakh p.a.

required_documents: Caste / Community Certificate issued by competent revenue authority
Income Certificate issued by Tehsildar / competent authority (valid for current financial year)
Previous Year Marks Sheet / Passing Certificate
Current Year College / Institute Admission Fee Receipt and Bonafide Certificate
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked & active DBT enabled)
offline_process: Online registration via NSP portal, verified by Institute Nodal Officer (INO) and District Nodal Officer (DNO).

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Provides adequate and timely credit support from banking system to farmers for their cultivation expenses, post-harvest costs, maintenance of farm assets, and activities allied to agriculture (dairy, fisheries, poultry) with effective interest rate as low as 4% p.a.
key_benefits: Credit limit up to ₹3,00,000 at 7% interest, subsidized to 4% p.a. on prompt repayment (3% Prompt Repayment Incentive - PRI). No collateral required for loans up to ₹1.60 lakh. Rupay KCC debit card for ATM withdrawals.

exclusions: Willful bank defaulters with overdue agricultural loans

required_documents: Aadhaar Card and Voter ID / PAN Card
Land Record Documents (Pahani / RTC / Khatauni / Land Title Deed)
Crop Sowing Certificate / Declaration of cropping pattern
No-dues certificate from nearby financial institutions (if loan exceeds ₹1.6 lakh)
offline_process: Submit 1-page simplified KCC form at nearest Commercial Bank branch, Regional Rural Bank (RRB), or Cooperative Bank.

scheme_name: Indira Gandhi National Widow Pension Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Financial security scheme under NSAP providing monthly pension to widows aged 40 to 79 years living below the poverty line.
key_benefits: Monthly pension of ₹300 (Central contribution) plus ₹700 to ₹1,500 (State contribution) totaling ₹1,000 to ₹1,800/month credited directly into the widow's bank account.

exclusions: Remarriage of the widow
Households not categorized as BPL or receiving regular government employment pension

required_documents: Age Proof Certificate (Aadhaar / Voter ID / School Certificate)
offline_process: Submit application to Gram Panchayat / Village Accountant / BDO in rural areas, or Municipal Ward / District Social Welfare Office in urban areas.

ministry: Ministry of Social Justice and Empowerment
description: Scheme for providing physical aids and assisted-living devices (hearing aids, wheelchairs, walkers, spectacles, artificial dentures, crutches) for senior citizens belonging to BPL category suffering from age-related disabilities/infirmities.
key_benefits: Free of cost distribution of standard assisted-living devices including Wheelchairs, Hearing Aids, Walking Sticks, Quadripods, Elbow Crutches, Tripods, Spectacles, Dentures, and Commode Chairs.

exclusions: Non-BPL senior citizens with high income
Senior citizens who have already received similar devices from ALIMCO/Govt within the last 3 years

required_documents: BPL Card / Income Certificate (showing monthly income < ₹15,000)
Medical Assessment Certificate from Government Medical Officer / Camp Doctor certifying impairment
offline_process: Attend ALIMCO assessment and distribution assessment camps organized by District Administration and Social Welfare Department.

ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship
description: Promotes apprenticeship training by sharing 25% of prescribed stipend subject to a maximum of ₹1,500 per month per apprentice directly to the apprentice's bank account via DBT during the training period with industrial enterprises.
key_benefits: Direct monthly stipend subsidy of ₹1,500 via DBT, on-the-job industrial skill training, and National Apprenticeship Certificate (NAC) recognized across India and globally.

exclusions: Candidates already holding full-time permanent employment
Candidates currently enrolled in another active apprenticeship contract

offline_process: Register online on Apprenticeship India portal and apply directly to empanelled industry apprenticeship vacancies.

ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
description: Credit-linked subsidy programme to generate continuous self-employment opportunities in rural and urban areas by setting up micro-enterprises. Provides 15% to 35% margin money government subsidy on project costs up to ₹50 lakh for manufacturing and ₹20 lakh for service units.
key_benefits: Government subsidy (Margin Money) of 15% to 35% of project cost: Urban (General: 15%, SC/ST/OBC/Women/Minorities: 25%), Rural (General: 25%, Special Categories: 35%). Maximum project cost ₹50 Lakh (Manufacturing) / ₹20 Lakh (Service).

exclusions: Existing units or units already availing government subsidy under PMRY, REGP, etc.
Business activities in negative list (meat/slaughterhouses, tobacco products, polythene bags < 50 microns, rural transport unless approved)

required_documents: Detailed Project Report (DPR) with machinery cost and financial projections
Rural Area Certificate from Gram Panchayat (for rural subsidy rate)
EDP (Entrepreneurship Development Training) Certificate (can be completed online post-approval)
optional_documents: Land / Building rental agreement or ownership papers
offline_process: Applications are submitted online via KVIC e-portal and processed by KVIC, KVIB, DIC, or Coir Board, followed by District Level Task Force Committee (DLTFC) interview.

ministry: Department of Skill Development, Entrepreneurship and Livelihood (Karnataka)
description: Financial assistance scheme by Government of Karnataka for unemployed graduates and diploma holders who passed out in the academic year 2022-23 onwards, providing monthly unemployment allowance for up to 2 years.
key_benefits: ₹3,000 per month for unemployed degree/postgraduate holders and ₹1,500 per month for unemployed diploma holders for a period of up to 2 years or until employment is secured, credited via DBT.

exclusions: Employed candidates in government, public sector, or private formal sector
Self-employed individuals registered under GST or receiving salary through EPF/ESI
Candidates pursuing higher education full-time
Candidates from outside Karnataka

required_documents: Karnataka Domicile Proof (Study certificate for at least 6 years in Karnataka or Ration Card)
Degree / Diploma Marks Cards and Passing / Convocation Certificate
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar seeded & DBT active)
offline_process: Apply online at Seva Sindhu portal or visit Karnataka One, Bangalore One, Grama One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra.

ministry: Department of Women and Child Development (Karnataka)
description: Flagship guarantee scheme of Karnataka providing ₹2,000 monthly financial aid to the woman head of household in eligible families across Karnataka.
key_benefits: ₹2,000 per month direct benefit transfer (DBT) into the bank account of woman head of the family (₹24,000 per year).

exclusions: Woman head or husband paying Income Tax (IT returns)
Woman head or husband filing GST returns

required_documents: Ration Card (APL / BPL / Antyodaya Card) with applicant woman marked as Head of Family
Aadhaar Card of the Woman Head of Family
offline_process: Register via Grama One, Karnataka One, Bangalore One, or Bapuji Seva Kendra centers across Karnataka.

ministry: Energy Department (Karnataka)
description: Provides up to 200 units of free electricity per month for domestic electricity consumers in Karnataka based on average household electricity consumption.
key_benefits: Zero electricity bill (100% subsidy) up to 200 units per month for eligible domestic residential households across Karnataka.

exclusions: Commercial and industrial electricity connections
Monthly electricity consumption exceeding 200 units in the billing cycle

required_documents: Electricity Account ID / Consumer Connection ID (found on BESCOM, HESCOM, GESCOM, MESCOM, CESC bills)
Rental / Tenancy Agreement (if living in rented house)
offline_process: Register at Karnataka One, Bangalore One, Grama One, or ESCOM sub-division offices.

ministry: Transport Department (Karnataka)
description: Provides free bus travel for all women domicile residents of Karnataka (including students and transgender persons) in non-premium State Road Transport Corporation buses (KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, KKRTC).
key_benefits: 100% free bus travel within Karnataka on ordinary, express, city, and suburban buses of KSRTC, BMTC, NWKRTC, and KKRTC with zero fare tickets issued on presenting valid ID.

exclusions: Luxury/Premium buses (Airawat, Club Class, Flybus, EV Power Plus, AC Vajra, Rajahamsa, Sleeper)
Inter-state bus travel beyond Karnataka border

required_documents: Government Photo ID Proof showing Karnataka Address (Aadhaar Card / EPIC Voter ID / Driving License / Ration Card / Passport)
optional_documents: Shakti Smart Card (when issued via Seva Sindhu)
offline_process: No pre-application required for daily travel; simply show any valid government ID proof with Karnataka address to conductor while boarding to obtain zero-fare pink ticket.

ministry: Food, Civil Supplies & Consumer Affairs Department (Karnataka)
description: Provides food security by guaranteeing 10 kg of food grains (or equivalent cash DBT of ₹170/person for 5 kg at ₹34/kg) per person per month to all members of Antyodaya Anna Yojana (AAY) and Priority Household (PHH/BPL) families in Karnataka.
key_benefits: 5 kg free food grains under PMGKAY plus 5 kg additional rice (or direct cash transfer of ₹170 per person per month via DBT) to ensure a total of 10 kg free food grains per month per person.

exclusions: Above Poverty Line (APL / Non-Priority Household) cardholders
Income tax payers

required_documents: Active Karnataka BPL / AAY Ration Card with all family members e-KYC verified
Aadhaar Card linked to Ration Card
Aadhaar-seeded active DBT bank account of the Head of the Family
offline_process: Fair Price Shops (PDS Ration Depots) in Karnataka distribute food grains upon biometric thumb impression. DBT cash component is automatically credited to the bank account of the card head.

scheme_name: Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
ministry: Ministry of Education (Department of Higher Education)
description: Merit-cum-means scholarship awarded to meritorious students from low-income families who have scored above the 80th percentile in Class 12 board examinations and are pursuing regular degree courses in higher education.
key_benefits: ₹12,000 per annum for the first three years of undergraduate degree and ₹20,000 per annum at postgraduate level (total up to ₹70,000 - ₹1,00,000 over 5-year integrated/professional courses) credited via DBT.

exclusions: Students pursuing correspondence / distance education courses
Students availing any other state or central government scholarship
Family income exceeding ₹4.50 lakh per annum

required_documents: Class 12th Board Marksheet with Roll Number
Income Certificate issued by competent revenue authority (income < ₹4.5L)
Bonafide Student Certificate and College Fee Receipt from the enrolled University / College
Bank Account Passbook (Aadhaar linked & DBT active)
offline_process: Apply exclusively online through NSP portal; verification is completed by College Nodal Officer (INO) and State Nodal Officer (SNO).

scheme_name: Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Scheme
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
description: Legal guarantee providing at least 100 days of guaranteed wage employment in every financial year to every rural household whose adult members volunteer to do unskilled manual work.
key_benefits: Legal guarantee of 100 days of unskilled wage work per rural household per year, statutory daily wages (₹240 to ₹375 depending on state) paid directly to bank/post office account via DBT with unemployment allowance if work is not provided within 15 days.

exclusions: Urban residents (scheme is statutory for rural Gram Panchayats only)
Minors below 18 years of age

required_documents: MGNREGA Job Card (issued free by Gram Panchayat)
Proof of residence in Gram Panchayat
offline_process: Submit application to Gram Panchayat office / Panchayat Development Officer (PDO) for Job Card and submit written work demand application (Form 6).

ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
description: Old age pension scheme for Small and Marginal Farmers (SMF) providing an assured monthly pension of ₹3,000 upon attaining the age of 60 years with matching monthly contribution from Central Government.
key_benefits: Assured lifelong monthly pension of ₹3,000 after attaining 60 years of age. Affordable monthly contribution of ₹55 to ₹200 (matched 1:1 by Central Govt) which can also be auto-debited from PM-KISAN payouts.

exclusions: Farmers covered under NPS, ESIC, EPFO, APY
Institutional landholders and income tax payers
Farmers with cultivable landholding exceeding 2 hectares

required_documents: Land Ownership Documents (Khatauni / RoR / Record of Rights)
PM-KISAN Beneficiary ID (optional for direct auto-debit of subscription)
offline_process: Enroll at nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) with Aadhaar and land records or through State Nodal Officers (PM-KMY).

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Empowering citizens with foundational AI and digital literacy certification.
key_benefits: Free certification and computer kit subsidy

ministry: Ministry of Electronics and Information Technology
description: Empowering citizens with foundational AI and digital literacy certification.
key_benefits: Free certification and computer kit subsidy

scheme_name: National Integrated Green Rooftop Subsidy Scheme
ministry: Ministry of New and Renewable Energy
description: Financial assistance of up to 40% for installation of residential rooftop solar panels.
key_benefits: Direct subsidy of ₹30,000 for 1-2kW systems and ₹60,000 for systems above 2kW.

exclusions: Commercial establishments

required_documents: Recent Electricity Bill with CA Number
offline_process: Visit local electricity distribution company (DISCOM) sub-division office.
